title: Sony Semiconductor Solutions and TSMC definitive image-sensor joint venture agreement (SEC-filed Form 6-K)
publisher: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Sony and TSMC signed a definitive agreement for a Kumamoto image-sensor joint venture targeting 2029 volume production; TSMC plans phased cash contributions of about JPY282 billion.
summary: The binding agreement adds a Japan-based advanced-process image-sensor growth option and government-support linkage, but Sony controls the venture, production is not expected until 2029 and contributions remain demand-conditioned.
